notes.title: Spooky v-sync update!
notes.notes:
[h1]V-Sync option added![/h1]
As computers have gotten faster, some of our wizards have run into trouble playing Tricky Towers alongside other activities like watching video online. If you were one of these unfortunate people, today’s update brings a new graphical option which may help!

Try turning on V-Sync by going to Settings, then use the right arrow to get to where you set your graphical options. There you should see the new V-Sync button – just check that and hit apply!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/96ef270f8923951a00628639f0a507c561cc3c53.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/96ef270f8923951a00628639f0a507c561cc3c53.jpg[/img][/url]

We've also improved controller support for MacOS. We hope this will resolve issues some players were having.

[b]Don’t forget your Halloween bricks![/b] We’re less than a month away, so it’s the perfect time to try out the free Halloween Brick Pack if you haven’t already! These bricks are decorated with pleasing pumpkins, beautiful bats, spooky spiders and cute cobwebs!

[i][b]Happy stacking, wonderful wizards![/b][/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/51dcde74ecf41cb770f1cc71e5aaebeddaccbaf0.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/51dcde74ecf41cb770f1cc71e5aaebeddaccbaf0.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Christmas update!
notes.notes:
Tricky Towers brings Christmas bricks to the game! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25546228/440e0be86916c331f33a9f7196a01b4f08ff3afe.png[/img]

We've made sure to add some Christmas decorations to the game. Now when hosting a friendly tournament after a lovely Christmas dinner, you can maintain the magical holiday spirit! 

And that's not all, the update also includes; 
[list]
[*]Added option to disable all explanations 
[*]Idle players are now automatically removed from online games 
[*]Added invite friend option to public games 
[*]Fixed bug where puzzle sometimes didn't have a base
[/list]

Happy Holidays everyone!

notes.title: 1.21 Update
notes.notes:
Hi, we're back with a small update. We've worked on the following:

[list]
[*] Physics are now much more consistent in all modes
[*] We've added a keybinding option for left and right rotation
[/list]

Thanks to everyone that helped us testing this update!

notes.title: 1.12 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everybody, we're back with another update. We've had the time to thoroughly test all possible controller combinations we have laying around the office and ironed out all the bugs we could find. 

This update includes:

[list]
[*] Xbox one & 360 controllers issue with rotating bricks is fixed
[*] Friend games are now completely private, so no random players can join 
[*] If you join a public game of a friend through the steam overlay, you now get XP
[/list]


That's it for this update, thanks again for all the feedback and suggestions, keep it coming!

- WeirdBeard

notes.title: 1.11 Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we just pushed the first update for Tricky Towers. Thanks to everybody for the great feedback. We've been hard at work fixing some bugs, luckily all the kind and fun reactions have kept us going :)

Anyway, let's get to the important stuff, what did we fix:

[list]
[*] Xbox one controller is now supported on all platforms
[*] Issue where input from xbox one & 360 controllers got switched around is also fixed
[*] Improved stability of online play 
[/list]

We'll keep working to improve and add to the game, so if you have any feedback or suggestions, we'd love to hear it here in the discussions or let us know on Twitter or Facebook.

Have a great weekend and thanks for playing Tricky Towers!

- WeirdBeard
